==Overview==
* Constructs a [[sinecure]] in Kalpamark, Hahnmark, as per the '''[[Poets_light_but_lamps#Zaboravi|Poet lights but lamps]]''' wind of fortune
* Announcement by the [[Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave]]

==Date==
* Spring 388YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 12 wains of weirwood
* 36 crowns in labour costs
* Three months to construct 

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Garden_of_Peaceful_Quietitude}}
==Outcome==
* Now complete, the title of [[Seeker of Quietitude]] will be available to appoint by the Wintermark Assembly for the first time at the Summer Solstice 388YE
